description: Extension of the AnyCodable type adding utility properties for extracting primitive types and collections, facilitating type conversions and safe unwrapping of underlying data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Bool, with special handling for NSNumber representing boolean.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an Int, including conversion from NSNumber when appropriate.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Double, including conversions from Int and NSNumber.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an array of AnyCodable.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Recursively converts AnyCodable into Foundation-compatible types.
